scripts.build: pnpm run build:react && pnpm run build:axe
scripts.build:react: esbuild react_diagnostics.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --legal-comments=none --banner:js='/* Generated from pinned React Scan and Bippy sources; React Grab-derived element context; see REACT_DIAGNOSTICS_NOTICE.md. */' --outfile=../assets/react_diagnostics.js
scripts.build:axe: esbuild axe_bridge.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --legal-comments=eof --banner:js='/* Generated from pinned axe-core sources; see AXE_NOTICE.md. */' --outfile=../assets/axe.js
